notes.setChanged: August 2026 (third pass): the base art was re-authored again and the set cut from six frames to five. The retired frame is ScreenShotAppStore4, the onboarding setup shot - 'Set up in under a minute' was never a reason to install. Shipped order is the array order, not the key number: overdue alert, garage, service history, log sheet, resale value. Frame keys are kept only because the geometry and the render pipeline hang off them.
notes.captionsReplaced: Unlike the earlier re-shoots, this one replaced the caption copy. The new art was authored with its own baked English headlines, and those headlines - not the older calibrated set - are now the source strings; every other locale was retranslated from them. The previous English set ('Know before it's overdue.', 'Every car in one place.', 'Your car's maintenance log.', 'Log a service in 15 seconds.', 'Take your data anywhere.') and its 15 translations are recoverable from git history. Frame 2 now claims 10 seconds, matching the art; the old copy said 15. One string does not match its art: the ScreenShotAppStore6 headline is baked as 'Your Entire Garage in One Place.', which is 31 characters and wraps to three lines in Cambay Bold at 128px in that frame's box. It ships as 'Every Car in One Garage.' instead - same claim, two lines. The baked headline is repainted anyway, so nothing in the image contradicts it.
notes.subtitles: The new art also carries a smaller grey subtitle under each headline. It does not ship: caption-band mode flattens everything above the mockup and repaints a single caption block, so the subtitle is erased in every locale including en-US. It survives only in the Downloads originals. Shipping it would need a second text run in shipkit's renderer.
notes.casing: English captions follow the art's title case. Other locales use their own sentence case - title case is not a convention in German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese or Swedish, and CJK has no case at all.
notes.lengths: Captions overlay a phone mockup, so each is held near the English source length. `maxLen` per locale is reported below - fr-CA/fr-FR run longest at 34 and are the ones to re-check for wrapping.
notes.inspectionTerms: Captions deliberately avoid inspection names (MOT/TUV/ITV/vehicle inspection), which differ per market and are already carried by each locale's subtitle.
notes.apostrophe: Captions use the typographic apostrophe U+2019, matching the live art and the store copy. An ASCII "'" renders as a straight vertical tick in Cambay and reads as a typo at 128px.
notes.wrapping: Every locale is 2 lines at the full 128px; no caption is shrunk. Line breaks were tuned by re-rendering, not by character count: the wrap is greedy inside each frame's own box, so ja - which breaks per character, having no spaces - has its comma placed where the break lands (7 characters in frames 1/2/3/6, 8 in frame 5) rather than mid-word.
